sources.statement: A strict boundary comparison of a holomorphic perturbation with a reference function preserves the number of enclosed zeros, counted with multiplicity.
sources.application: Compare each Taylor polynomial on a disk boundary with its linear term; use exact uniform coefficient bounds for every point of a closed parameter segment.
